source.sql: SELECT toDate(bucket, 'Asia/Taipei') AS day, round(sum(avg_value), 3) AS kwh FROM trustiot.tenant_telemetry_1h WHERE point = 'energy' AND bucket >= now() - INTERVAL 7 DAY GROUP BY day ORDER BY day
